proposal.hypothesis: Packing 4 one-SIMD-per-row groups per threadgroup, plus FP32 exp2 and a single reciprocal multiply, reduces scheduling and math cost for 64x257 softmax versus the incumbent.
One SIMD group per row caching up to 9 FP32 values per lane in registers enables max/sum via SIMD reductions with no threadgroup barriers or extra input passes for the 64x257 shape.
